result.summary: Found 2 layout/content clipping issues: restaurant names and details cut off in the Fastest near you carousel and incomplete category chip visibility beyond expected partial last item.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the third restaurant card title is truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') and the delivery fee line may also be incomplete due to fixed card width or insufficient text wrapping/truncation handling.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, use ellipsis with full name on a secondary line, or widen cards / reduce font so names and fees display fully without cutting words.

issues.description: Category filter chips row shows a partial empty/white chip on the far right with no label visible, which can look like a broken or unfinished control rather than a natural scroll peek.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partial chips still show meaningful content, add fade/scroll affordance, or pad the row so only intentional content peeks at the edge.
